description.para: Gas dry deposition to water surfaces

Calculates gas dry deposition velocity to water surfaces based on Henry's law coefficient, wet bulb temperature calculations, and diffusivity considerations following established parameterizations.
CHEMMECHGAS_OPT
Chemical mechanism option selector
CHEMMECHGAS_TOT
Total number of gas species in chemical mechanism
TEMP2
Mean temperature just above surface (K)
QV2
Mean mixing ratio just above surface (kg/kg)
USTAR
Friction velocity at surface (m/s)
RA
Aerodynamic resistance (s/cm)
DEP_IND
Gas deposition species index (depends on gas mechanism)
DEP_OUT
Output water surface gas dry deposition rate (cm/s) [output]
P.C. Campbell
February 2025
Based on Slinn et al. (1978), Fairall et al. (2007), and Fritschen and Gay (1979)

detaileddescription.para: This group contains subroutines for calculating gas dry deposition velocities to vegetation, soil, snow, urban surfaces, and water based on Zhang et al. (2003) and other established parameterizations.
